evals.prompt: Wire this repository to my local HVE-Core clone at ~/repos/forks/microsoft-hve-core. Do not install the extension.
evals.expected_output: A local .hve-core symlink, dynamically generated VS Code chat locations, project-local Copilot CLI skill and agent links, local Git exclusion, and validation without marketplace installation.
expectations: Runs scripts/wire_hve_core.py rather than performing the symlink, exclude, settings, and registration steps by hand.
Creates a project-root .hve-core symlink resolving to the supplied absolute clone path.
Adds exactly one .hve-core rule to the repository-local path returned by git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude rather than the shared .gitignore.
Configures agents, prompts, instructions, skills, and hooks through project-relative .hve-core paths.
Each chat.*Locations value is a JSON object mapping paths to boolean true, not an array.
Excludes the installer and experimental skill packages.
Does not configure the .hve-core/.github/skills root as a VS Code skills location.
Links each non-excluded skill package into the project's .github/skills directory.
Links each non-excluded agent package and root-level agent profile into the project's .github/agents directory.
Tells the user to run /skills reload when skill links change during an active session.
Does not install or modify a marketplace extension.

evals.prompt: Use my local HVE-Core fork for this project. It already has a .vscode/settings.json with Python and editor settings, so preserve those.
evals.expected_output: The existing settings remain intact while HVE-Core chat location maps are merged surgically.
expectations: Preserves unrelated Python, editor, and existing chat location settings.
Adds only missing HVE-Core location entries.
Preserves JSONC comments when the existing file uses JSONC.
Keeps every chat.*Locations setting as an object map from path to boolean true.
Every newly enabled path exists as a directory.

evals.prompt: Set up local HVE-Core here. There is already a real .hve-core directory from an older experiment.
evals.expected_output: The collision is surfaced and no existing directory is replaced without explicit approval.
expectations: Detects that .hve-core is an existing directory rather than the requested symlink.
Stops before deleting, moving, or replacing the directory.
Requests an explicit collision disposition from the user or reports that approval is required when non-interactive.
Leaves .hve-core contents, VS Code settings, Git excludes, and unrelated worktree state unchanged.

evals.prompt: Link this project to my local HVE-Core clone and include the experimental agents and skills too.
evals.expected_output: The normal local wiring completes without experimental components, and the user is told experimental is not supported.
expectations: Creates a project-root .hve-core symlink resolving to the supplied local clone.
Tells the user that experimental components are not supported by this skill.
Configures no experimental location for any artifact type.
Links no experimental package into the project's .github/skills directory.
Still excludes the installer skill package.
Completes the rest of the wiring rather than refusing the whole request.

evals.prompt: Set up local HVE-Core here. A regular file named .hve-core already exists and contains data I need.
evals.expected_output: The regular-file collision is reported and setup stops without mutating the project.
expectations: Detects that .hve-core is a regular file.
Stops before deleting, moving, replacing, or writing inside .hve-core.
Requests an explicit collision disposition from the user or reports that approval is required when non-interactive.
Leaves the file bytes, VS Code settings, Git excludes, and unrelated worktree state unchanged.

evals.prompt: Wire this project to ~/repos/forks/microsoft-hve-core. The existing .hve-core symlink points to a different checkout.
evals.expected_output: The mismatched symlink and both targets are reported, and setup stops without replacing the link.
expectations: Detects that .hve-core resolves to a different target than the requested clone.
Reports both the existing and requested targets.
Stops before unlinking or replacing the symlink.
Leaves the symlink, alternate target, VS Code settings, Git excludes, and unrelated worktree state unchanged.

evals.prompt: Wire this linked Git worktree to my local HVE-Core clone, then verify that running the same setup again makes no changes.
evals.expected_output: The worktree uses the repository-local exclude returned by git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude and a second run is idempotent.
expectations: Creates or reuses a project-root .hve-core symlink resolving to the supplied clone.
Writes exactly one .hve-core rule to the path returned by git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude.
Preserves unrelated exclude rules even when the original file lacks a trailing newline.
Uses git check-ignore -v --no-index to validate local rule attribution.
A second run leaves symlink metadata, settings bytes, exclude bytes, Git status, source state, and extension state unchanged.

evals.prompt: Wire this project to local HVE-Core, but ~/repos/forks/microsoft-hve-core does not exist yet.
evals.expected_output: Setup stops and the user is offered help cloning the official repository into the default local path.
expectations: Expands the default path relative to the current user's home directory.
Stops before creating .hve-core, VS Code settings, or Git exclude entries.
Offers to work with the user to clone https://github.com/microsoft/hve-core.git into ~/repos/forks/microsoft-hve-core.
Does not silently clone or choose a different destination.

evals.prompt: I already ran local HVE-Core setup for VS Code. Make the same HVE-Core skills available in Copilot CLI too.
evals.expected_output: The non-experimental skill packages are linked into the project's own .github/skills directory so Copilot CLI discovers them for this project only, without global registration and without disturbing VS Code.
expectations: Links each non-excluded package under the source .github/skills directory into the project's .github/skills directory.
Uses a relative symlink target that resolves through the .hve-core symlink.
Does not link the .github/skills root, installer, or experimental.
Does not run copilot skill add or otherwise register skills globally.
Adds a local Git exclusion for each created link.
Leaves the project's own skills in .github/skills untouched.
Leaves the VS Code chat location settings unchanged.
Tells the user to run /skills reload in the active Copilot CLI session.

evals.prompt: Wire this project to local HVE-Core. Its tracked .vscode/settings.json must not be changed without my approval.
evals.expected_output: Setup reports the required settings changes and stops before mutating any project state.
expectations: Detects that .vscode/settings.json is tracked by Git.
Exits through the tracked-settings approval gate before creating .hve-core, project links, or exclude rules.
Reports the exact missing and stale settings entries.
Changes the tracked file only after explicit approval via --allow-tracked-settings.

evals.prompt: My HVE-Core checkout removed a skill package. Reconcile this project's local wiring.
evals.expected_output: Only obsolete HVE-Core links, settings entries, and local exclude rules are removed, while current and project-owned configuration remains.
expectations: Identifies stale symlinks by their targets through the project .hve-core link.
Removes the stale link and its exact local exclude rule.
Removes the obsolete .hve-core chat location from strict JSON settings.
Leaves unrelated project skills, agents, settings, and exclude rules unchanged.
Verification passes after reconciliation.

evals.prompt: Stop using my local HVE-Core checkout in this project and remove only its local wiring.
evals.expected_output: The HVE-Core project links, settings entries, exclude rules, and matching .hve-core symlink are removed without touching project-owned configuration.
expectations: Runs the script's unwire mode rather than deleting paths ad hoc.
Removes only symlinks whose targets point through .hve-core.
Removes only .hve-core chat location entries and matching local exclude rules.
Preserves project-owned skills, agents, settings, and unrelated exclude rules.
Stops without mutation when JSONC needs a manual merge or tracked settings lack explicit approval.

evals.prompt: Repair this Windows project's local HVE-Core wiring. Verify says .hve-core resolves to a \\?\-prefixed version of the requested drive path, and every project skill and agent link created by the previous run is broken.
evals.expected_output: The equivalent root link is reused, exact-target legacy project links are recreated with native Windows path syntax, and verification succeeds without weakening collision protection.
expectations: Treats the \\?\-prefixed root target and the requested drive path as the same filesystem location rather than a collision.
Repairs only broken project symlinks whose stored destinations are semantically identical to the generated HVE-Core targets.
Creates relative project links with native path syntax so skill directories, agent directories, and root agent files resolve on Windows.
Continues to block a symlink whose destination differs from the generated target.
Verification reports no broken managed links after repair.
A second apply run makes no changes.
